Changes for Last Light: static mesh integration, placement, scale/orientation and
subtle procedural idle scale. No original skeleton/animation is claimed and no
author endorsement is implied. Source GLBs retained unchanged; hashes in manifest.
0.5.8 also applies a separate desaturated ash/brown scale material to dragon mesh
copies; original model materials/textures remain unchanged in the source asset.

Moon fox / kitsune derives from Fox by Alexei Ostapenko, CC BY 4.0:
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/fox-4e37c303f8a241aaa2511bd9f3019273
Changes: existing anatomical partitions; initial pale/five-tail treatment replaced
in 0.5.8 by a larger single-tailed dark hound with skull-like fur markings.
Source files/provenance retained in assets/vendor/hostile_sources/.
